player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Lenane ka leng le tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 0 le 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row kapa col e ka ntle ho range.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sele e se ntse e hapiloe.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Sebapali se lokela ho bapala boto e latelang ea micro.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Boto ea micro e se e hapiloe.

next_board.any: boto efe kapa efe e nyane ea micro board

game_action.played: Player {player_id} e tšweletse ka micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (lera {row}, kholo {col}). Player {opponent_id} a tšwanetse hantle go tšweletsa ka {nxt_txt}.
